originality.rationale: Fused live retrieval (SerpBase/Serpent + OpenAlex + Crossref, no partial failure) finds only the general foundations: Chekanov 5_2 DGA, Fuchs-Rutherford/Leverson augmentation-ruling correspondence and Ng-Rutherford count formula, Etnyre-Ng survey stabilization behaviour, and Ng atlas 0324/0626 tables. No source records Reeb-chord differentials, raw 4-vs-2 Z-graded counts, or 48/48 agreement for these two 27-generator mK7_2.0 plats. The general degree-0 stabilization-doubling principle does not mechanically imply the exact ledger: it delegates counting to front-specific differentials, degree distributions (chi*=3 vs 1) and ruling data that were uncomputed for these fronts.
